claims.text: The new training algorithm (EM+Prune) finds better solutions to the optimization problem than the original recursive training algorithm, leading to higher morphological segmentation accuracy.
The evaluation of the training algorithm's performance includes metrics such as boundary precision, recall, and F1-score, indicating its effectiveness compared to the Morfessor Baseline model.
The Morfessor EM+Prune algorithm achieves a lower Morfessor cost compared to the Baseline algorithm, demonstrating its superior optimization capabilities.
